test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution aims at securing for the citizens a uniform civil code throughout the territory of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 44.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Uniform Civil Code **calls for the formulation of **one law for India**, which would be **applicable **to **all religious communities **in matters such as **marriage**, and **divorce adoption**. 
 
• The Code comes under **Article 44 **of the Constitution, which lays down that the state should endeavour to secure a **Uniform Civil Code **for **the citizens **throughout the **territory **of **India**
 
• The **Saffron Party **was the **first** to promise the implementation of **UCC **if it comes to power and the issue was part of its **2019 election manifesto**.
 
• The objective of This article of the **Directive Principles **in the Indian Constitution was to address the **discrimination against vulnerable **groups and **harmonize diverse cultural groups **across the **country**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Article 46__ calls for the promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections.
 
• __**Article 43A**__ Participation of workers in the management of industries.
